title: Derived pushforward factors through the direct-image algebra
statement: For a finite morphism f:X -> Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], assume the derived module categories of X, Y and A=f_*O_X exist [def-pc-derived-category]. With g:X -> (Y,A) [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], rho the right derived scalar restriction along f.c, and the derived direct images [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-direct-image], there is a natural isomorphism Rg_* followed by rho ≅ Rf_* on the entire derived category D(O_X). No boundedness or quasi-coherence hypothesis on its input is imposed.

proof.text: Scalar restriction is exact: kernels and cokernels have unchanged underlying abelian sheaves. Apply the finite limit and colimit preservation results for algebra scalar restriction in def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module; termwise scalar restriction therefore descends through localization and agrees with its right derived functor.

The sectionwise definitions make F followed by scalar restriction S definitionally equal to scheme module direct image (Iso.refl). Apply the upstream Functor.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory for exact S, rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso for F followed by S, and rightDerivedFunctorNatIso to this underived identity. Their composite is the asserted isomorphism on the entire derived category, without any bound or quasi-coherence restriction.

theorem finite_affine_derived_factorization {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    : Nonempty (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f) ⋙
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).rightDerivedFunctor ≅
          schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
